scripts.icon: mkdir -p AppIcon.iconset && swiftc -swift-version 5 -framework AppKit icon.swift -o gen-icon && ./gen-icon && for s in 16 32 128 256 512; do sips -z $s $s AppIcon.iconset/icon_512x512@2x.png --out AppIcon.iconset/icon_${s}x${s}.png >/dev/null; sips -z $((s*2)) $((s*2)) AppIcon.iconset/icon_512x512@2x.png --out AppIcon.iconset/icon_${s}x${s}@2x.png >/dev/null; done && iconutil -c icns AppIcon.iconset && rm -rf AppIcon.iconset gen-icon
scripts.build: [ -f AppIcon.icns ] || npm run icon; swiftc -O -swift-version 5 -framework AppKit -framework WebKit "$PWD/main.swift" -o PromptForge && mkdir -p 'Prompt Forge.app/Contents/MacOS' 'Prompt Forge.app/Contents/Resources' && mv PromptForge 'Prompt Forge.app/Contents/MacOS/' && cp Info.plist 'Prompt Forge.app/Contents/' && cp AppIcon.icns 'Prompt Forge.app/Contents/Resources/'
scripts.install-app: npm run build && rm -rf "$HOME/Applications/Prompt Forge.app" && cp -R 'Prompt Forge.app' "$HOME/Applications/"
